name: helm_release
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk Kubernetes Helm release (Flux HelmRelease).

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this Helm release.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the Helm release resource.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description. Not echoed back by the API, so it is never read from the response.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this Helm release to a cloud provider account. Not echoed back by the API, so it is never read from the response.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (EKS cluster) this Helm release belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group.

attributes.name: namespace_name
attributes.description: Kubernetes namespace the HelmRelease object is created in.

attributes.name: api_version
attributes.description: Flux HelmRelease CRD apiVersion. Override if your cluster's Flux serves a different version (e.g. helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2beta2).

attributes.name: interval
attributes.description: Interval at which the release is reconciled (Go duration, e.g. 5m, 1h).

attributes.name: target_namespace
attributes.description: Namespace the chart is installed into (defaults to the HelmRelease namespace).

attributes.name: release_name
attributes.description: Helm release name (defaults to the resource name).

attributes.name: storage_namespace
attributes.description: Namespace Helm stores its release history in (defaults to the HelmRelease namespace).

attributes.name: depends_on_releases
attributes.description: Other HelmReleases that must be ready before this one reconciles. Ordering only — no data flows between them. Named depends_on_releases because depends_on is a reserved Terraform meta-argument.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the HelmRelease depended on.

attributes.name: namespace
attributes.description: Namespace of the dependency. Defaults to this release's namespace.

attributes.name: ready_expr
attributes.description: CEL expression overriding what "ready" means for the dependency.

attributes.name: service_account_name
attributes.description: Kubernetes ServiceAccount, in the HelmRelease namespace, that Flux impersonates when running Helm actions.

attributes.name: timeout
attributes.description: Time to wait for any individual Kubernetes operation during a Helm action (Go duration, e.g. 5m). Flux defaults to 5m when omitted, and each action block below may override it. This is the in-cluster Helm timeout and is unrelated to the `timeouts` block, which bounds how long Terraform itself waits.

attributes.name: max_history
attributes.description: Number of Helm release revisions to keep in storage. Flux defaults to 5 when omitted.

attributes.name: suspend
attributes.description: Suspend reconciliation of the release. The Helm release itself is left in place.

attributes.name: persistent_client
attributes.description: Re-use one Helm client across reconciles. Flux defaults to true.

attributes.name: post_render_strategy
attributes.description: How post-renderers interact with Helm hooks: nohooks, combined, or separate. Flux defaults to combined.

attributes.name: wait_strategy_name
attributes.description: Implementation Flux uses to wait for resources to become ready: poller or legacy. Flux defaults to poller.

attributes.name: common_metadata_labels
attributes.description: Labels applied to every object the chart renders.

attributes.name: common_metadata_annotations
attributes.description: Annotations applied to every object the chart renders.

attributes.name: kube_config_secret_ref_name
attributes.description: Name of a Secret holding a kubeconfig, so the release targets a remote cluster.

attributes.name: kube_config_secret_ref_key
attributes.description: Key within the kubeconfig Secret.

attributes.name: values
attributes.description: Inline Helm values as a YAML or JSON string.

attributes.name: values_from
attributes.description: Values sourced from ConfigMaps or Secrets.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Source kind: ConfigMap or Secret.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the ConfigMap or Secret.

attributes.name: values_key
attributes.description: Key in the source holding the values (defaults to values.yaml).

attributes.name: target_path
attributes.description: Where in the values tree to graft the referenced data, as a dot-separated path. When set, the referenced value is treated as a single value rather than a values map to merge.

attributes.name: optional
attributes.description: Tolerate a missing ConfigMap or Secret instead of failing the reconcile.

attributes.name: install
attributes.description: Options for the Helm install action — the first release of the chart, and any re-install after an uninstall remediation.

attributes.name: timeout
attributes.description: Timeout for the install action (Go duration). Overrides the release-level timeout.

attributes.name: crds
attributes.description: How the chart's CRDs are handled on install: Skip (never apply), Create (apply only if absent), or CreateReplace (apply and update existing). Flux defaults to Create.

attributes.name: create_namespace
attributes.description: Create target_namespace if it does not already exist.

attributes.name: replace
attributes.description: Re-use the name of a deleted release still present in Helm history.

attributes.name: disable_wait
attributes.description: Do not wait for the installed resources to become ready before marking the release successful.

attributes.name: disable_wait_for_jobs
attributes.description: Do not wait for Jobs created by the chart to complete.

attributes.name: disable_hooks
attributes.description: Skip the chart's install hooks.

attributes.name: disable_open_api_validation
attributes.description: Skip validating rendered templates against the cluster's OpenAPI schema.

attributes.name: disable_schema_validation
attributes.description: Skip validating the supplied values against the chart's values.schema.json. Requires Flux 2.4 or later.

attributes.name: remediation
attributes.description: What Flux does when the install fails.

attributes.name: retries
attributes.description: Number of retries after a failed install. Use -1 to retry indefinitely. Flux defaults to 0.

attributes.name: remediate_last_failure
attributes.description: Remediate (uninstall) after the final retry is exhausted, instead of leaving the failed release in place.

attributes.name: ignore_test_failures
attributes.description: Treat a Helm test failure as success, so it does not trigger remediation. Only meaningful when test.enable is true.

attributes.name: strategy
attributes.description: Retry strategy for the install action.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the install strategy.

attributes.name: retry_interval
attributes.description: Interval between retries (Go duration). Applies to the retry strategy only.

attributes.name: disable_take_ownership
attributes.description: Do not take ownership of existing resources that are not tracked by this release.

attributes.name: server_side_apply
attributes.description: Apply the rendered manifests server-side instead of client-side.

attributes.name: skip_crds
attributes.deprecated: Deprecated by Flux. Use crds = "Skip" instead.
attributes.description: Skip installing the chart's CRDs. Deprecated by Flux in favour of crds.

attributes.name: upgrade
attributes.description: Options for the Helm upgrade action, run whenever the chart version or values change.

attributes.name: timeout
attributes.description: Timeout for the upgrade action (Go duration). Overrides the release-level timeout.

attributes.name: crds
attributes.description: How the chart's CRDs are handled on upgrade: Skip (never apply), Create (apply only if absent), or CreateReplace (apply and update existing). Flux defaults to Skip.

attributes.name: force
attributes.description: Replace resources through delete/recreate when a patch would fail.

attributes.name: preserve_values
attributes.description: Merge the last release's values on top of the supplied ones (helm upgrade --reuse-values).

attributes.name: cleanup_on_fail
attributes.description: Delete newly created resources when the upgrade fails.

attributes.name: disable_wait
attributes.description: Do not wait for the upgraded resources to become ready before marking the release successful.

attributes.name: disable_wait_for_jobs
attributes.description: Do not wait for Jobs created by the chart to complete.

attributes.name: disable_hooks
attributes.description: Skip the chart's upgrade hooks.

attributes.name: disable_open_api_validation
attributes.description: Skip validating rendered templates against the cluster's OpenAPI schema.

attributes.name: disable_schema_validation
attributes.description: Skip validating the supplied values against the chart's values.schema.json. Requires Flux 2.4 or later.

attributes.name: remediation
attributes.description: What Flux does when the upgrade fails.

attributes.name: retries
attributes.description: Number of retries after a failed upgrade. Use -1 to retry indefinitely. Flux defaults to 0.

attributes.name: strategy
attributes.description: How a failed upgrade is remediated: rollback to the previous revision, or uninstall the release. Flux defaults to rollback.

attributes.name: remediate_last_failure
attributes.description: Remediate after the final retry is exhausted, instead of leaving the failed release in place. Flux defaults to true when retries is greater than 0.

attributes.name: ignore_test_failures
attributes.description: Treat a Helm test failure as success, so it does not trigger remediation. Only meaningful when test.enable is true.

attributes.name: strategy
attributes.description: Retry strategy for the upgrade action.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the upgrade strategy.

attributes.name: retry_interval
attributes.description: Interval between retries (Go duration). Applies to the retry strategy only.

attributes.name: disable_take_ownership
attributes.description: Do not take ownership of existing resources that are not tracked by this release.

attributes.name: server_side_apply
attributes.description: Server-side apply mode for the upgrade. Note this is a string here, unlike install.server_side_apply.

attributes.name: chart_name_change_strategy
attributes.description: What to do when the chart name changes: Reinstall the release, or apply an InPlaceUpdate.

attributes.name: rollback
attributes.description: Options for the Helm rollback action, run when upgrade.remediation.strategy is rollback.

attributes.name: timeout
attributes.description: Timeout for the rollback action (Go duration). Overrides the release-level timeout.

attributes.name: force
attributes.description: Replace resources through delete/recreate when a patch would fail.

attributes.name: recreate
attributes.description: Recreate the Pods of the rolled-back resources.
attributes.deprecated: No effect on Helm 3; modeled for round-trip fidelity only.

attributes.name: cleanup_on_fail
attributes.description: Delete newly created resources when the rollback fails.

attributes.name: disable_wait
attributes.description: Do not wait for the rolled-back resources to become ready.

attributes.name: disable_wait_for_jobs
attributes.description: Do not wait for Jobs created by the chart to complete.

attributes.name: disable_hooks
attributes.description: Skip the chart's rollback hooks.

attributes.name: server_side_apply
attributes.description: Server-side apply mode for the rollback.

attributes.name: uninstall
attributes.description: Options for the Helm uninstall action, run on remediation and when the release is deleted.

attributes.name: timeout
attributes.description: Timeout for the uninstall action (Go duration). Overrides the release-level timeout.

attributes.name: deletion_propagation
attributes.description: Cascading delete policy applied to the release's resources. Flux defaults to background.

attributes.name: keep_history
attributes.description: Keep the Helm release history after uninstalling, so the release can be rolled back.

attributes.name: disable_wait
attributes.description: Do not wait for the release's resources to be removed.

attributes.name: disable_hooks
attributes.description: Skip the chart's uninstall hooks.

attributes.name: test
attributes.description: Options for the Helm test action, run after a successful install or upgrade.

attributes.name: enable
attributes.description: Run the chart's tests after install and upgrade. A test failure triggers remediation unless the matching remediation.ignore_test_failures is true.

attributes.name: timeout
attributes.description: Timeout for the test action (Go duration). Overrides the release-level timeout.

attributes.name: ignore_failures
attributes.description: Treat test failures as success for both install and upgrade, without setting remediation.ignore_test_failures on each.

attributes.name: filters
attributes.description: Restrict which of the chart's tests are run. When any include filter is present, only the named tests run.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the test to filter on.

attributes.name: exclude
attributes.description: Exclude the named test instead of including it.

attributes.name: drift_detection
attributes.description: Detect, and optionally correct, cluster-side drift from the rendered manifests.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Drift handling: enabled (correct it), warn (report only), or disabled. Flux defaults to disabled.

attributes.name: ignore
attributes.description: Paths excluded from drift comparison, optionally scoped to particular objects.

attributes.name: paths
attributes.description: RFC 6901 JSON pointers to ignore, e.g. /spec/replicas.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Restrict the rule to matching objects. Omit to apply it to every object.

attributes.name: group
attributes.description: API group of the objects to match.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: API version of the objects to match.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Kind of the objects to match.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the objects to match.

attributes.name: namespace
attributes.description: Namespace of the objects to match.

attributes.name: annotation_selector
attributes.description: Annotation selector expression, e.g. env in (staging, prod).

attributes.name: label_selector
attributes.description: Label selector expression, e.g. app.kubernetes.io/name=podinfo.

attributes.name: post_renderers
attributes.description: Kustomize post-render steps applied to the manifests the chart renders.

attributes.name: kustomize
attributes.description: Kustomize patches and image overrides.

attributes.name: patches
attributes.description: Patches applied to the rendered manifests.

attributes.name: patch
attributes.description: The patch document as inline YAML or JSON — either a strategic-merge patch or a JSON6902 patch list.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: Which rendered objects to patch. Omit to patch every object.

attributes.name: group
attributes.description: API group of the objects to match.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: API version of the objects to match.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Kind of the objects to match.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the objects to match.

attributes.name: namespace
attributes.description: Namespace of the objects to match.

attributes.name: annotation_selector
attributes.description: Annotation selector expression, e.g. env in (staging, prod).

attributes.name: label_selector
attributes.description: Label selector expression, e.g. app.kubernetes.io/name=podinfo.

attributes.name: images
attributes.description: Container image overrides applied to the rendered manifests.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Image name to match, e.g. ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo.

attributes.name: new_name
attributes.description: Replacement image name.

attributes.name: new_tag
attributes.description: Replacement image tag. Mutually exclusive with digest.

attributes.name: digest
attributes.description: Replacement image digest. Mutually exclusive with new_tag.

attributes.name: health_check_exprs
attributes.description: Custom CEL readiness rules, so Flux can judge health for kinds it has no built-in rules for.

attributes.name: api_version
attributes.description: API version of the kind these rules apply to.

attributes.name: kind
attributes.description: Kind these rules apply to.

attributes.name: current
attributes.description: CEL expression that evaluates true when the resource is ready.

attributes.name: in_progress
attributes.description: CEL expression that evaluates true while the resource is still reconciling.

attributes.name: failed
attributes.description: CEL expression that evaluates true when the resource has failed.

attributes.name: chart_name
attributes.description: Chart name (or path) within the referenced HelmRepository source. Use with chart_source_ref_*.

attributes.name: chart_version
attributes.description: Chart version or semver range.

attributes.name: chart_interval
attributes.description: Interval at which the chart source is checked for updates.

attributes.name: chart_reconcile_strategy
attributes.description: When to reconcile the chart: ChartVersion or Revision. Server-defaulted to ChartVersion by Flux when omitted.

attributes.name: chart_source_ref_kind
attributes.description: Kind of the chart source (e.g. HelmRepository).

attributes.name: chart_source_ref_name
attributes.description: Name of the chart source object.

attributes.name: chart_ref_kind
attributes.description: Kind of a directly-referenced chart source (e.g. OCIRepository or HelmChart). Alternative to chart_name/chart_source_ref_*.

attributes.name: chart_ref_name
attributes.description: Name of the directly-referenced chart source object.

attributes.name: chart_ref_namespace
attributes.description: Namespace of the directly-referenced chart source object.

attributes.name: chart_values_files
attributes.description: Values files to merge, as paths relative to the chart root. Later entries win.

attributes.name: chart_ignore_missing_values_files
attributes.description: Skip missing entries in chart_values_files instead of failing the reconcile.

attributes.name: chart_source_ref_api_version
attributes.description: API version of the chart source object.

attributes.name: chart_source_ref_namespace
attributes.description: Namespace of the chart source object.

attributes.name: chart_ref_api_version
attributes.description: API version of the directly-referenced chart source object.

attributes.name: chart_verify_provider
attributes.description: Signature verification provider for an OCI-backed chart: cosign or notation.

attributes.name: chart_verify_secret_ref_name
attributes.description: Name of the Secret holding the trusted public keys used to verify the chart.

attributes.name: chart_metadata_labels
attributes.description: Labels stamped onto the generated HelmChart object (not onto the rendered workloads — that is common_metadata_labels).

attributes.name: chart_metadata_annotations
attributes.description: Annotations stamped onto the generated HelmChart object (not onto the rendered workloads — that is common_metadata_annotations).

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Kubernetes labels applied to the HelmRelease.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Kubernetes annotations applied to the HelmRelease.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version. Not echoed back by the API, so it is never read from the response.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status.

attributes.name: helm_release_id
attributes.description: ID of this Helm release, for reference by dependent resources.

readyFailureStates.True: Helm release failed to reconcile and Flux is not retrying further
